'''The Silver Dolphin''' is an inn in the [[Illian (city)|City of Illian]].{{ref/book|2|9}}

==Activities==
[[Yarin Maeldan]] tells [[Bayle Domon]] that his room in The Silver Dolphin was tossed. The perpetrators made it look like it was thieves by stealing some silver, but they left Yarin's jewelled belt buckle.{{ref/book|2|9}}
